title: BlueOval SK battery manufacturing automation
summary: At SK C&C, I supported the design, construction, and automation of Ford–SK On’s BlueOval SK battery manufacturing facilities in the United States, connecting factory software with equipment and production workflows.
tools: PLC · Machine vision · Robotics · 3D inspection · Simulation
details: My work included automation software, PLC and vision integration, robotics, and the use of drawings, 3D inspection, and simulation to support implementation. Working with physical equipment and production constraints shaped my interest in digital representations that remain useful on the factory floor.
scale_intro: Kentucky described BlueOval SK Battery Park as the largest economic development project in the state’s history in 2022. Its scale gives context to my work connecting software, equipment, and production processes.
scale_note: Kentucky Battery Park figures reported in 2022–2023; investment and planned campus capacity, not individual performance metrics or current production.

press.summary: A construction update documents nearly 2,600 onsite construction workers and plans for more than 80 GWh of annual battery capacity.

title: Reinforcement learning agents in CARLA
summary: Autonomous driving agents using DQN and A2C in the CARLA simulator, with synchronous and asynchronous simulation environments.

title: Rumour detection with BERT and GCN
summary: A model for classifying discussion stances and detecting rumours in Twitter and Reddit data from RumourEval 2019. The project combines BERT with a three-layer graph convolutional network.
details: Reported results: 67% accuracy for stance classification and 70% for rumour detection. Selected as the best study in the Advanced Natural Language Processing class.

title: Music NFTs and audience engagement
summary: A Measure of Music conference project examining music NFT releases using Chartmetric data. The analysis considered Shawn Mendes and Tory Lanez releases alongside follower and streaming trends.
tools: Chartmetric · Music analytics · Measure of Music 2022
details: The analysis did not establish a direct relationship between the selected NFT releases and follower or streaming changes. Available metrics limited the conclusions that could be drawn about their impact.
